gameConfig.failState: Run ends with a jumpscare if (a) a bad guest is still inside when the night ends, (b) a deadly guest is accepted, or (c) the player rejects or kicks out two genuine guests. One heart, one life.

mistakeRules.acceptBadGuest: The guest stays in the monitor and can still be kicked before the night ends.
mistakeRules.rejectGoodGuest: Each genuine guest rejected costs half a heart. Rejecting two genuine guests ends the run.
mistakeRules.kickGoodGuest: Each genuine guest kicked costs half a heart. Kicking or rejecting two genuine guests in total ends the run.
mistakeRules.acceptDeadlyGuest: Instant death with jumpscare. Cannot be kicked.

rng.night2AnomalyMinimum: max(3, 6 - goodGuestsNotYetUsed). Only 6 good guests exist, so this keeps night 2 from running out.

schemaNotes.idMatchesVisible: true = ID card agrees with the 'visible' traits. false = at least one mismatch (see idInfo vs visible).
schemaNotes.tellType: How a disguised guest can be caught: idMismatch | dialogue | nightLog | glitch | none
schemaNotes.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Consequence at the end of the night if the player lets this guest in and never kicks them. The game is one life only.
schemaNotes.specialEffect: Optional. Extra behavior triggered by a guest, such as audio played when they are accepted.
schemaNotes.killsPlayer: true = instant death and jumpscare the moment they are accepted.
schemaNotes.difficulty: 1 = easy to spot, 2 = needs questions, 3 = only the night log gives it away
schemaNotes.commandmentLink: Which idol or virtue the guest represents (First and Second Commandments theme). Shown on the results screen.

nonAnomaly.name: Faith

dialogue.greeting: Good evening. A quiet room, please. I won't be any trouble.
dialogue.askDetails: I'm only here for one night. I need rest before a long walk tomorrow.
dialogue.askId: Of course. Here you go.

nightLog: Faith was praying quietly
Faith was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Faith
commandmentLink.meaning: Trusting God above everything else

nonAnomaly.name: Amor

dialogue.greeting: Hello! Sorry it's so late. Do you have a room? I brought some bread, if you're hungry.
dialogue.askDetails: I'm visiting family nearby. They live too far to reach tonight.
dialogue.askId: Sure, hold on. Let me find it.

nightLog: Amor shared food with the guest next door
Amor was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Love
commandmentLink.meaning: Putting others before yourself

nonAnomaly.name: Hope

dialogue.greeting: Hi! I've had a rough week, but things are looking up. Got a room?
dialogue.askDetails: I lost my job last month. I have an interview in the morning.
dialogue.askId: Here. I know it's a bit worn.

nightLog: Hope was rehearsing for tomorrow
Hope was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Hope
commandmentLink.meaning: Trusting that God provides, not money

nonAnomaly.name: Mercy

dialogue.greeting: Good evening, dear. Long shift? You look tired. I only need a small room.
dialogue.askDetails: I'm a nurse on night rotation. I just need a few hours of sleep between shifts.
dialogue.askId: Here, and my hospital badge too, if that helps.

nightLog: Mercy was worried for the other guests
Mercy was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Mercy
commandmentLink.meaning: Compassion over profit

nonAnomaly.name: Fidelis

dialogue.greeting: Evening. I've stayed here before. Same room, if it's free.
dialogue.askDetails: I stay every year on the same night. A promise I made to a friend.
dialogue.askId: Here. It hasn't changed in years.

nightLog: Fidelis was keeping watch by the window
Fidelis was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Fidelity
commandmentLink.meaning: Staying loyal to God and to your promises

nonAnomaly.note: Looks suspicious because he says he's a regular. He is truthful. Players who reject every 'regular' will be wrong here.

nonAnomaly.name: Valerius

dialogue.greeting: Room for one. Don't worry about my bag. It looks heavy but it's just books.
dialogue.askDetails: I'm a security guard heading home. I'd rather rest than drive tired.
dialogue.askId: Here. Check anything you need.

nightLog: Valerius was walking the hallway to make sure doors were locked
Valerius was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Courage
commandmentLink.meaning: Standing firm for what is right

nonAnomaly.note: Walking the hallway at night can look suspicious, but he is safe. Teaches players not to kick based on one odd log line.

nonAnomaly.name: Prudencia

dialogue.greeting: Good evening. Before I check in, may I see your guest book and where the fire exits are? I like to know where I'm sleeping.
dialogue.askDetails: I travel for work, so I check everything twice. Locks, exits, IDs. Yours too, if you don't mind.
dialogue.askId: Of course. Take your time. I'd be more worried if you didn't look closely.

nightLog: Prudencia checked the lock twice, then was asleep
Prudencia wrote down every exit in a notebook, then was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Prudence
commandmentLink.meaning: Testing everything before trusting it (1 John 4:1). This is the virtue the whole game asks of the player

nonAnomaly.note: Red herring. Her many questions and her interest in the exits can look like a thief casing the motel, but she is honest. She even asks you to check her ID closely.

nonAnomaly.name: Humberto

dialogue.greeting: Good evening, sir. I'm afraid I can't pay the full rate tonight. I can fix a leaky tap or sweep your hallway in exchange, if you'll have me.
dialogue.askDetails: My bus was cancelled and my wallet is nearly empty. I only need a bed. I'll leave early so you can sell the room again.
dialogue.askId: Here. It's old and the corners are worn, but it's real.

nightLog: Humberto swept the hallway before bed
Humberto fixed a dripping tap in the bathroom, then was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Humility
commandmentLink.meaning: Serving instead of ruling, and welcoming the stranger. Valuing a person over profit (Matthew 25:35)

nonAnomaly.note: Tests the money theme. A player who rejects every guest who cannot pay in full protects revenue but turns away an honest man. He is truthful and harmless.

nonAnomaly.name: Verity

dialogue.greeting: Hello. Before you check my ID, I should warn you: I cut my hair last week. The card is out of date.
dialogue.askDetails: I donated it to a children's wig program. I'll update my ID next month. I'd rather tell you now than have you wonder.
dialogue.askId: There. Long hair on the card, short hair on me. Ask me anything else on it: my birthday, my address, my middle name.

nightLog: Verity left a note at the front desk about her out-of-date ID
Verity was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Truthfulness
commandmentLink.meaning: Telling the truth first, even when it makes you look suspicious (Ephesians 4:25)

nonAnomaly.note: Looks like Belli, because the ID and the guest disagree on hair. Verity volunteers the mismatch before she is asked, explains it and invites more questions. Belli hides it. idMatchesVisible is false here, but Verity is NOT an anomaly: use anomaly.isAnomaly, not idMatchesVisible, to decide who is truly bad.

nonAnomaly.name: Stewart

dialogue.greeting: Good evening. One room, please. I'll pay the full rate, and I'll need a receipt. Everything on paper, please.
dialogue.askDetails: I'm an accountant. I like a clean record. I'll also leave a little extra for the cleaner. Honest work should be paid for.
dialogue.askId: Here, along with my business card. Write it all down. I'd rather you keep records.

nightLog: Stewart left an envelope at the front desk for the next guest in need
Stewart reviewed his receipts, then was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Stewardship
commandmentLink.meaning: Money as a servant, not a master. Using it honestly and generously instead of worshipping it. You cannot serve both God and money (Luke 16:13)

nonAnomaly.note: Red herring for the money theme. He talks about money first, like Amon, but he insists on paperwork, pays in full and gives some away. Amon skips paperwork and offers bribes.

nonAnomaly.name: Ana

dialogue.greeting: Good evening, anak. A small room, please. I won't need the lights. I'll be up late, praying.
dialogue.askDetails: I stay awake on this night every year, praying for my family. Don't worry about me, I won't disturb anyone.
dialogue.askId: Here, anak. I've had it since before you were born, I think.

nightLog: Ana stayed awake all night praying by the window
Ana never slept. She kept vigil until morning

commandmentLink.name: Devotion
commandmentLink.meaning: Giving God your time and attention, not your image or your money. Watching and praying (Mark 14:38, Luke 2:37)

nonAnomaly.note: Red herring for Lilli. Both stay awake all night, but Ana is praying. Players have to read the whole log and her dialogue, not react to one keyword.

nonAnomaly.name: Gracia

dialogue.greeting: Good evening! Do you have your smallest room? Honestly, a bed and a door that locks is already more than I hoped for today.
dialogue.askDetails: I'm on my way home from a provincial trip. I don't need anything fancy. Thank you for even opening this late.
dialogue.askId: Here you go. Thank you for being careful. It's a comfort that someone is.

nightLog: Gracia wrote a thank-you note and left it on the desk, then was asleep
Gracia returned a spare blanket she did not need, then was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Contentment
commandmentLink.meaning: Being thankful for enough instead of chasing more (1 Timothy 6:6-8, Hebrews 13:5). The opposite of Behe

nonAnomaly.note: Foil for Behe. She asks for the smallest room and thanks you for it. Teaches players that friendly is not the tell. Behe is friendly too, but never satisfied.

nonAnomaly.name: Lazaro

dialogue.greeting: Evening. Any room with a clock will do. I'm up at five for the early shift, and I plan to be asleep by ten.
dialogue.askDetails: I run two jobs, so I know what tired looks like. Tonight I'm not working. My kids made me promise to rest, and I keep my promises.
dialogue.askId: Here. I'd show you my kids' names too, but we'd be here all night.

nightLog: Lazaro called his children to say goodnight, then was asleep by ten
Lazaro set three alarms, then was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Rest
commandmentLink.meaning: Working hard but trusting God enough to rest, and putting family before the paycheck (Psalm 127:2, Matthew 11:28). The opposite of Molo

nonAnomaly.note: Foil for Molo. Both are hardworking. Lazaro stops, calls his family and sleeps. Players who kick anyone who mentions work will be wrong.

nonAnomaly.name: Severo

dialogue.greeting: Room. One night. I'll pay now so we don't have to talk later.
dialogue.askDetails: Truck driver. Twelve hours on the road and I'm not in the mood for small talk. That's all there is to it. No tricks.
dialogue.askId: Here. Read it twice if you want. I'm rude, not a liar.

nightLog: Severo grumbled about the hallway noise, then was asleep
Severo left the exact change for the room on the desk, then was asleep

commandmentLink.name: Integrity
commandmentLink.meaning: Plain honesty even when he isn't pleasant. Let your yes be yes and your no be no (Matthew 5:37)

nonAnomaly.note: Looks like a bad guest because he is curt and impatient, but every fact he gives checks out. Teaches that rude is not the same as dangerous. The anomalies are the charming ones.

nonAnomaly.name: Rosario

dialogue.greeting: Good evening, dear. A room with a table by the bed, please. I carry a small crucifix and I need somewhere to set it down.
dialogue.askDetails: It reminds me who I pray to. I don't pray to the object. It's only a reminder, like keeping a letter from someone you love.
dialogue.askId: Here. Take your time. It's older than your motel, so go easy on it.

nightLog: Rosario knelt beside the bed and prayed, her small crucifix on the table
Rosario prayed quietly, then was asleep by ten

commandmentLink.name: Reverence
commandmentLink.meaning: Using a symbol to point to God instead of replacing Him. The Second Commandment forbids worshipping carved idols, not remembering who you worship (Exodus 20:4-5). The opposite of Baal

nonAnomaly.note: Foil for Baal. Both bring an object and kneel. Rosario prays to God with a reminder on the table. Baal bows to the object, demands it have its own room and asks others to bow too. Players have to read what is being worshipped.

anomaly.name: Belz

specialEffect.note: Quiet whispering in the background for the rest of the night. Stops if Belz is kicked.

dialogue.greeting: Evening. I believe I've stayed here before, though the hours blur together.
dialogue.askDetails: The usual room, if it is still free. I tend to remember places by their feel, not their names.
dialogue.askId: Of course. I only thought the staff might recognize me by now.

nightLog: Belz never entered the room

anomaly.tell: Claims to be a regular, but the guest book has no record of him. The 'What you see' header text glitches while he is on screen. The log shows he never entered his room.
anomaly.disguise: Everything on his ID matches what you see.

commandmentLink.name: Pride
commandmentLink.meaning: Making yourself the center and treating yourself like a god

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Belli

dialogue.greeting: A room, please. I have had a long day, so I would appreciate a quick check-in.
dialogue.askDetails: I travel light and keep to myself. If something needs arranging, tell me plainly and I will handle it.
dialogue.askId: It is still me. The card has seen better days, but the important details should be clear.

nightLog: Belli was rearranging the furniture
Belli was ignoring the motel rules

anomaly.tell: ID says Short Hair but she visibly has Long Hair. She dismisses every rule.
anomaly.disguise: Charming and confident.

commandmentLink.name: Self-rule
commandmentLink.meaning: Treating your own will as the highest law

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Aba

dialogue.greeting: I need a quiet room tonight, somewhere built solid enough that the noise stays outside.
dialogue.askDetails: It is my first stay, unless I have mistaken this place for another. The far room looks like it would suit me.
dialogue.askId: There you are. I have never been fond of paperwork, but it is all in order.

nightLog: Aba was pounding on the walls
Aba was testing the locks on other doors

anomaly.tell: Says it's his first time, then names the sturdiest room without being told. ID says 19 but he speaks like someone very old.
anomaly.disguise: Polite, quiet voice.

commandmentLink.name: Power
commandmentLink.meaning: Worshipping strength and control

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Lilli

dialogue.greeting: Hi! Does the room have a mirror? I like to make a good impression after traveling.
dialogue.askDetails: A decent mirror would be lovely. Harsh lighting can make anyone look tired, don't you think?
dialogue.askId: Here you are. The photograph is unkind, but I promise I look more like myself in person.

nightLog: Lilli stood at the mirror all night
Lilli never slept

anomaly.tell: Her 'What you see' traits flicker between two descriptions for a split second each time the screen refreshes. She obsesses over mirrors.
anomaly.disguise: Warm and flattering toward the player.

commandmentLink.name: Vanity and Appearance
commandmentLink.meaning: Worshipping appearance and approval

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Levi

dialogue.greeting: A room for one, please. I hope I have not arrived after all the quiet rooms were taken.
dialogue.askDetails: I am easy to please. Just give me something comparable to what the other guests received.
dialogue.askId: Certainly. And forgive my curiosity—has the motel been busy this evening?

nightLog: Levi was standing outside another guest's door
Levi was watching the other guests

anomaly.tell: Keeps asking about other guests and their rooms. Everything on his ID checks out, so only the night log exposes him.
anomaly.disguise: Friendly and curious, never rude.

commandmentLink.name: Envy
commandmentLink.meaning: Wanting what others have more than what God has given

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Amon

dialogue.greeting: Good evening. I am happy to cover the usual rate, and a little extra for any inconvenience.
dialogue.askDetails: I have had a fortunate year. If a rule causes trouble, perhaps there is a practical way to make the trouble disappear.
dialogue.askId: Surely the reservation is enough, but I understand. Let us keep this quick for both of us.

nightLog: Amon was counting money all night
Amon offered another guest money to switch rooms

anomaly.tell: Mentions money before anything else and tries to bribe you to skip the ID check. Directly ties to the theme: MONEY.
anomaly.disguise: A generous, successful businessman.

commandmentLink.name: Money (Mammon)
commandmentLink.meaning: Serving wealth instead of God

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends. Motel also loses money

anomaly.name: Behe

dialogue.greeting: Hi! I would love the largest room available, if it is not too much trouble. My luggage takes up space.
dialogue.askDetails: Could I have a few extra towels and perhaps a little more food? I sleep better when I am prepared for every possibility.
dialogue.askId: It should answer everything. While you have it, do you know whether there is a larger room upstairs?

nightLog: Behe emptied the minibar and the vending machine
Behe demanded a third room and was still not satisfied

anomaly.tell: Never satisfied. Asks for more rooms, more food and more of everything, and keeps asking even after she gets it. Easy to catch once you notice she is never content with any answer.
anomaly.disguise: Cheerful and bubbly, with plenty of compliments.

commandmentLink.name: Excess (Never Enough)
commandmentLink.meaning: Making 'more' your god. Whoever loves money never has enough (Ecclesiastes 5:10)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends. Motel also loses money

anomaly.name: Mephi

dialogue.greeting: Good evening. The motel is offering a welcome arrangement tonight; it only needs your signature before I check in.
dialogue.askDetails: It is a modest exchange: a complimentary room now, with a small favor to be discussed later. Nothing unusual in business.
dialogue.askId: There should be no difficulty with it. Take a look, by all means, though the print is rather cramped.

nightLog: Mephi slipped a contract under every guest's door
Mephi collected signatures from guests who did not read the page

anomaly.tell: The ID says Average build but he visibly looks Skinny. It is a subtle mismatch, and he tries to rush you past it with a 'free' form he wants signed unread. Mirrors loan traps and hidden fine print.
anomaly.disguise: Polished and professional, generous with 'free' offers.

commandmentLink.name: The Bargain (Deceit)
commandmentLink.meaning: Giving yourself away for a 'free' offer without reading the cost. Hidden fine print and debt traps are the modern version. What good is it to gain the whole world and lose your soul? (Mark 8:36)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Baal

dialogue.greeting: Good evening. I am traveling with my patron, who would be most comfortable in the finest room you have.
dialogue.askDetails: He is a quiet companion, though particular about his surroundings. I have learned to bring a suitable gift when we travel.
dialogue.askId: Certainly. I would not want to cause offense by keeping you waiting—he is rather attentive to such things.

nightLog: Baal set a small golden calf on the dresser and bowed to it all night
Baal asked another guest to bow down too

anomaly.tell: The 'What you see' text flashes gold for a split second whenever he mentions his patron. He travels with a golden calf that needs its own room, and his night log shows him bowing to it.
anomaly.disguise: A devout, soft-spoken traveler who sounds religious.

commandmentLink.name: False Gods (The Golden Calf)
commandmentLink.meaning: Worshipping something made instead of the one who made you. The golden calf of Exodus 32 is the exact sin the Second Commandment forbids (Exodus 20:4-5)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Molo

dialogue.greeting: Evening. A desk and a reliable outlet would be enough. I may be working late, so the bed is not important.
dialogue.askDetails: There is a final meeting tomorrow, and I would rather finish properly than sleep halfway through the job. I can rest afterward.
dialogue.askId: Of course. I am on a schedule, but I will not make that your problem.

nightLog: Molo made call after call and never lay down
Molo ignored three calls from her family: 'Not now, I'm closing a deal'
Molo never ate or slept

anomaly.tell: Sounds like a tired, hardworking professional, so she passes for a good guest. Only the night log shows what she is sacrificing for success. Modern burnout is the same as the old offering to Moloch.
anomaly.disguise: A dedicated, hardworking professional who deserves sympathy.

commandmentLink.name: Success (The Sacrifice)
commandmentLink.meaning: Sacrificing family, rest and health for the sake of success. Moloch was the god who demanded sacrifices, and the modern version is burnout and neglect for profit. Seek first God's kingdom (Matthew 6:33)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Legion

specialEffect.note: Repeats the previous guest's lines word for word. If Legion were the first guest there would be nothing to echo, so the game must never place her first. She only gives her own answer when asked for ID. The lines below are the fallback if the echo cannot run.

dialogue.greeting: Good evening. A room, please. Whatever arrangement worked for the last guest should suit me too.
dialogue.askDetails: I do not need anything special. Most people want the same simple comforts, and I am no different. I think.
dialogue.askId: My name is Legi Onn. We are—sorry, I mean I am—just one traveler, here for the night.

nightLog: Legion repeated every conversation she heard through the walls
Legion changed her story each time another guest spoke to her

anomaly.tell: Repeats the previous guest's greeting almost word for word, and her ID answer slips from 'we' to 'I'. She has no opinion of her own.
anomaly.disguise: Agreeable, friendly and easy to get along with.

commandmentLink.name: The Crowd (Conformity)
commandmentLink.meaning: Putting what everyone else thinks and does before God. 'My name is Legion, for we are many' (Mark 5:9). Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong (Exodus 23:2)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Lupo

dialogue.greeting: Peace, friend. I am traveling to a revival and could use a quiet place to gather my thoughts before morning.
dialogue.askDetails: Faith is strengthened by generosity. Offer a little kindness tonight, and I will remember your motel in my prayers.
dialogue.askId: The card is only a worldly formality, but I will show it if that helps you feel comfortable.

nightLog: Brother Lupo went door to door collecting 'seed offerings' from the other guests
Brother Lupo preached outside the rooms and asked every guest for money

anomaly.tell: Quotes 'God helps those who help themselves' as if it were scripture. It is not in the Bible. He also asks for a 'seed offering' and uses his faith to pressure you. Scripture warns about wolves in sheep's clothing (Matthew 7:15) and about teachers who exploit people through greed (2 Peter 2:3).
anomaly.disguise: A gentle, friendly pastor who flatters the player's faith.

commandmentLink.name: False Prophet
commandmentLink.meaning: Someone who uses God's name to serve himself and his wallet. A wolf in sheep's clothing (Matthew 7:15)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends. Motel also loses money

anomaly.name: Pai

dialogue.greeting: Hey! You must have heard I was coming. Reserve me the room with the best lighting, please. I'll need a good spot to film a short video.
dialogue.askDetails: I'm kind of a big deal online. People follow me everywhere. I'll tag the motel if the room looks good, which is basically free advertising for you.
dialogue.askId: You really don't know who I am? Fine. Here. Fun fact: it has my best angle.

nightLog: Pai filmed himself in the hallway and asked other guests to watch
Pai knocked on doors asking guests to like and follow him

anomaly.tell: Keeps asking whether you know who he is and offers 'free advertising' in place of payment. His ID is in order, so the dialogue is the giveaway. He treats the player as an audience instead of a host.
anomaly.disguise: Charming and famous-sounding, with a huge smile.

commandmentLink.name: Fame (Applause)
commandmentLink.meaning: Living for likes and applause instead of for God. Do not practice your righteousness in front of others to be seen by them (Matthew 6:1). They loved human praise more than praise from God (John 12:43)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends. Motel also loses money

anomaly.name: Asmo

dialogue.greeting: Evening. Let's make this fun. Flip a coin: heads, the room is free. Tails, you charge me double. Fair odds, right?
dialogue.askDetails: I don't believe in fixed prices. Life is a bet. Everyone is already gambling, so why not enjoy it? All I need is a card table.
dialogue.askId: A little wager? If I'm lying about my name, I'll pay for the whole night. If I'm not, you owe me a drink. Deal?

nightLog: Asmo rolled dice alone all night and talked to them
Asmo bet another guest his room key in a card game

anomaly.tell: Tries to turn the room price into a coin flip and bets on whether his ID is real. Asking for details shows he treats everything as chance. His ID matches, so the dialogue gives him away.
anomaly.disguise: Playful and fun, the life of the party.

commandmentLink.name: Luck and Gambling
commandmentLink.meaning: Trusting chance and quick winnings instead of God and honest work. Whoever gathers money little by little makes it grow (Proverbs 13:11). The love of money is a root of all kinds of evil (1 Timothy 6:10)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends. Motel also loses money

anomaly.name: Belphe

dialogue.greeting: Good evening! A room, and while you're at it, a word about your future. Tell me, how would you like to double your savings by morning?
dialogue.askDetails: It's a tiny investment with no risk at all. You put in a little, bring in two friends, and everyone earns. I'm only staying one night, but the returns last forever.
dialogue.askId: Of course, but do you really want to waste time on paperwork when real money is waiting? Sign here first, then I'll show you anything you like.

nightLog: Belphe pitched an 'investment opportunity' at every door in the hallway
Belphe collected cash from three guests and promised to double it by morning

anomaly.tell: Pitches a no-risk, double-your-money scheme and asks you to recruit others. His ID matches what you see, so only the dialogue shows he is a pyramid-scheme recruiter. If it sounds too good to be true, it is.
anomaly.disguise: A smooth, friendly mentor who sounds like a successful businessman.

commandmentLink.name: Get-Rich-Quick
commandmentLink.meaning: Chasing easy money instead of honest work and trust in God. Wealth gained hastily will dwindle (Proverbs 13:11). Whoever hastens to be rich will not go unpunished (Proverbs 28:20)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends. Motel also loses money

anomaly.name: Sangui

dialogue.greeting: Welcome, welcome. No need to pay tonight, dear. Consider it a favor. We can settle up later. Just a little extra, that's all.
dialogue.askDetails: I help travelers who are short on cash. A room tonight, a small payment every week. It's practically charity. Everyone I've helped is still paying me back, happily.
dialogue.askId: The card? It's a few years old. People change, don't you think? What matters is our little arrangement.

nightLog: Sangui lent money to three guests and wrote their names in a small black book
Sangui knocked on a guest's door to remind them of a debt they never agreed to

anomaly.tell: ID says Light Skin but she visibly has Tan Skin. She offers 'free' favors that quietly turn into debt. She wants your name on a promise more than your money tonight.
anomaly.disguise: Warm and motherly, always offering to help.

commandmentLink.name: Debt (The Lender)
commandmentLink.meaning: Becoming enslaved to what you owe. The borrower is slave to the lender (Proverbs 22:7). Interest and debt traps are the modern chains that make money your master

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends. Motel also loses money

anomaly.name: Asta

dialogue.greeting: Evening. Before the room, tell me about the safe. Is it really fireproof? And the doors, how many bolts?
dialogue.askDetails: I trust no one. I've learned that the only safe thing is a full wallet. I travel with everything I own, and I count it every hour.
dialogue.askId: I should be asking for yours first. Anyone could be a thief. Fine, here is mine.

nightLog: Asta barricaded the door with the dresser and slept sitting on his suitcase
Asta counted his savings every hour and never let the suitcase out of his arms

anomaly.tell: Like Prudencia he asks about locks and exits, but his questions are about protecting his money, not testing the place, and his night log shows him barricaded in with his cash. His ID checks out, so only the night log separates him from the honest guests.
anomaly.disguise: A cautious, careful traveler who sounds sensible.

commandmentLink.name: Security (Trusting Savings)
commandmentLink.meaning: Trusting savings and locks instead of God. Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the Lord (Psalm 20:7). Do not store up treasures on earth (Matthew 6:19)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

anomaly.name: Phari

dialogue.greeting: Good evening. I'll pay in full, and I'd like everyone in the lobby to see it. A man should be known for his generosity.
dialogue.askDetails: I donate to many causes, as I always tell people. Last week I gave more than most families earn in a year. Please write that down somewhere visible.
dialogue.askId: Certainly. But why not read it aloud? It's an honor to be known. And do mention the donations.

nightLog: Phari taped a note about his donations to the lobby wall
Phari made a show of handing money to a guest while the others watched

anomaly.tell: Looks like Stewart on the surface: he pays in full and gives money away. The difference is the audience. He announces every gift and wants it recorded, while Stewart gives quietly. His ID matches, so only the night log shows he gives to be seen.
anomaly.disguise: A generous, respected pillar of the community.

commandmentLink.name: Hypocrisy (Giving to Be Seen)
commandmentLink.meaning: Giving to be seen instead of to serve. When you give, do not announce it with trumpets (Matthew 6:2). Honoring God with the lips while being far from Him inside (Isaiah 29:13)

anomaly.ifAdmittedNotKicked: Game over (jumpscare) when the night ends

dialogue.greeting: Peace be with you. I have come a long way, and I trust you will recognize why I am here.
dialogue.askDetails: You are cautious; that is understandable. Still, some things lose their meaning when we insist on proving them.
dialogue.askId: I carry what you need to know. If a card will settle the matter, then you may read it.

anomaly.tell: Demands to be trusted without any questions. The ID looks self-written and 'verified' by himself. The glow around his face flickers. He is angry when tested.
anomaly.disguise: Radiant, calm and perfectly matching his ID.

commandmentLink.name: False Christ
commandmentLink.meaning: A false savior. Scripture warns against false christs and false prophets (Matthew 24:24)

dialogue.greeting: What a lovely place. I have passed through many homes, but this one feels unusually welcoming. May I come in?
dialogue.askDetails: People often want the same small comforts: safety, rest, and someone who understands them. I can provide those things.
dialogue.askId: Here. You will find every detail in its proper place, exactly as you would expect.

anomaly.tell: Everything about him is too perfect. The age on his ID reads 0. His shadow is missing from the guest screen. Text on the screen glitches into other words.
anomaly.disguise: An angel of light who says everything the player wants to hear.

commandmentLink.name: The Deceiver
commandmentLink.meaning: Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light (2 Corinthians 11:14)
